status_model.adapter_static_reachable: At least one declared execution surface reaches packaged implementation code rather than only a suggestion or editable template.
status_model.contract_valid: The versioned module contract parses and all referenced packaged assets satisfy release rules.
status_model.controlled_fixture_artifact_payload_relo: The controlled case serialized one or more artifact payloads and independently reloaded their recorded byte identities.
status_model.controlled_fixture_executed_and_reloaded: A controlled fixture has exercised the registered implementation and its declared output reload path.
status_model.controlled_fixture_process_json_round_tr: The controlled case returned a complete normalized process result that was decoded and checked against its closed output contract.
status_model.current_project_reviewed: The current project has observed execution, artifact reload, scientific review, and an accepted decision; generic release reports never set this axis.
status_model.engineering_validated: The registered implementation executed a controlled case and independently reloaded its declared outputs.
status_model.executable: A controlled fixture executes the registered implementation and reloads declared outputs; this does not imply current-project scientific completion.
status_model.fixture_declared: A controlled case is declared; declaration alone is not execution evidence.
status_model.method_validated: Engineering validation is supplemented by a current representative or public-data case for the exact registered method slice.
status_model.portable_receipt_identity: The checked readiness catalog binds portable case, module, compatibility, validated projection, reload, and round-trip identity. Complete observed output and runtime digests remain in the run-specific validation receipt and are intentionally excluded from cross-host release identity.
status_model.project_promoted: A current project result has passed observed execution, reload, scientific review and an explicit FORMAL promotion decision; release reports always leave this false.
status_model.representative_or_public_case_validated: A current dependency-scoped representative or public-data case passed its declared gates.
status_model.scaffolded: A no-edit contract exists, but no external scientific workflow is executed.
status_model.validated: Executable evidence is supplemented by a current dependency-scoped public-data acceptance case.
